run_metadata.attempt_policy: one normal generation; up to two retries only after runtime exceptions; malformed/contract outputs retained without retry

reporting_only_enrichment.description: Post-run tokenizer-derived completion token counts and cap flags; raw completion strings, prompts, fields and executor outputs were not altered.

run_metadata.source_tracking_note: Full extraction began from the working tree before the scoped runner was committed; start-of-run source digest was not captured. Per-case prompt, generated text, settings and model files/revision are retained. Do not attribute latency or exact implementation to a later commit SHA.
